cand.title: International Exhibition of Inventions Geneva 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong evidence of a dated organized programme and a plausible airport-corridor lodging/meeting/catering mechanism, discounted where venue/hotel is committed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Priority 1: Caroline Simonet, Director of the Exhibition, explicitly named in the official 2026 awards document; relevant for organizer/delegation introductions and confirmation of the 2027 housing account owner. Her 2027 remit and contracting authority are not separately published. Priority 2: Anna Veskova, Palexpo Hospitality Manager since January 2025 according to her professional profile; an official INDEX26 accommodation page names her at info@palexpohotelreservation.ch. Relevant for hotel-supplier onboarding and housing routing, but her Inventions 2027 assignment and authority remain unconfirmed. Frédéric Vormus is a verified 2026 media contact, not a verified lodging buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced: 28 April–2 May 2027, Palexpo, Halls 4 and 5, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. The organizer homepage, venue calendar and 2027 exhibitor regulations agree on actual activity dates. Exhibitor registration is open; that is not hotel sourcing being open. This edition falls within the requested horizon. No official 2028 announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: conditional fit for a self-contained inventor, exhibitor, university or national delegation requiring airport-side accommodation, breakfast and a small off-site briefing/dinner. A proposed 20–120-room group is a commercial targeting band, not published demand. YOTEL’s 237 rooms and approximately 250-theatre largest meeting room are not a replacement venue for this international exhibition. Founex is outside the event municipality; airport-corridor access is relevant but a scheduled group transfer to Palexpo must be costed. The hotel advertises an airport shuttle, which must not be treated as an event-specific Palexpo shuttle or guaranteed group capacity. This is a city-edge/airport lodging proposition, not an established resort retreat requirement.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo Halls 4 and 5 are publicly confirmed for 2027; no venue tender was found. Territory: Geneva Airport corridor, municipality of Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not downtown Geneva and not Lausanne. Palexpo is the exhibition/congress venue, not a competing hotel. Published venue confirmation does not establish hotel inventory commitments.
findings.historicalRotation: 2024: 17–21 April, Palexpo Hall 1; 2025: 9–13 April, Palexpo Hall 1; 2026: 11–15 March, Palexpo; 2027: 28 April–2 May, Palexpo Halls 4 and 5. These editions remain in Geneva/Le Grand-Saconnex: no rotating destination is evidenced. Annual recurrence is explicit in organizer/venue descriptions, but dates vary and no 2028 dates should be inferred. Pre-event brochure audience figures must not be relabeled as same-year actual attendance.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 sourcing is unconfirmed: no official edition-specific housing platform, room-block list, open RFP, hotel allotment or incumbent hotel names were located. The historical 2024 official brochure explicitly states: “Accommodation Palexpo Hotel Reservation – info@palexpohotelreservation.ch”. The current generic Palexpo service says: “Whether you’re outlining your requirements or pre-booking a number of rooms, our simple, interactive online booking tool will handle all your requests”. It publishes info@palexpohotelreservation.ch / +41 (0)22 761 10 11. This establishes a credible accommodation intermediary and historical event pathway, not a confirmed exclusive 2027 bureau mandate or available block. Official named 2027 hotels located: none. A separate commercial ExpoBeds listing explicitly says it is not affiliated with the organizer; the surfaced Hotel Ibis Budget Archamps Porte de Geneve offer is not an official block or incumbent commitment.
findings.organizationStructure: The organizer is Palexpo SA, not a separately evidenced membership association or a scaling-company organizer. The official history says Palexpo SA has organized the exhibition since 2017; 2027 regulations describe it as the company owning/managing/operating the exhibition and congress centre. Palexpo therefore acts as organizer and venue operator. Palexpo Hotel Reservation is the accommodation-service pathway, not proven event owner or confirmed 2027 exclusive PCO. Government and WIPO patronage does not establish purchasing authority.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Palexpo is already the exhibition venue. The 2027 regulations, article 13.5, reserve on-site fixed catering to Palexpo Restaurants and hall catering to it and approved partners: YOTEL should not pitch unrestricted on-site exhibition catering. Palexpo Hotel Reservation advertises a broad negotiated hotel network, creating an established competing distribution pathway; it does not disclose an Inventions 2027 hotel block. No sourced event sell-out, displacement, overflow shortage, contracted incumbent hotel or hotel room-night total was located. Do not turn historical visitor totals into overnight demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Caroline Simonet via expo@inventions-geneva.ch / +41 22 761 11 11 and Anna Veskova via the published Palexpo Hotel Reservation mailbox, info@palexpohotelreservation.ch / +41 (0)22 761 10 11. Ask who owns Inventions 2027 accommodation, whether suppliers outside Canton Geneva are accepted, whether hotels/blocks are already contracted, and which delegations independently book. Offer a conditional 20–120-room delegation proposal with breakfast, a separately priced Palexpo transfer and optional off-site briefing/dinner; request stay dates including setup/teardown before quoting. Do not hold inventory or forecast pickup without a named buyer, rooming requirements and contracting route. If 2027 is closed, ask for the next supplier-review date, without assuming announced 2028 dates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The upcoming 2027 edition is accessible as a relationship-development target, not a verified live hotel RFP. Exhibition venue is committed; accommodation procurement access is unknown. Historical bureau use suggests beginning with Palexpo Hotel Reservation and the exhibition director, then obtaining permission to approach suitable delegations. Exhibitor registration being open does not prove accommodation purchasing is open. No evidence establishes YOTEL inclusion, exclusion or a room commitment elsewhere.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: pursue an airport-corridor hotel-supplier position and repeat delegation accounts, rather than trying to relocate this Palexpo-based exhibition. Annual recurrence supports a repeat-account strategy; a 2028 edition and its dates are not officially established in reviewed sources. Future capture depends on the bureau accepting a Founex property, delegation transfer tolerance, actual rate comparisons and procurement timing—not on assumed overflow.
